method: Browsed the top posts under #indianpetparents and #petshopindia, plus one pet-business announcement post, in a logged-in browser. No view or like counts were captured, so these are patterns that recur among top-ranked posts, not measured winners.

observations.seen: Text-on-video hooks about Indian pet-parent life: 'Indian mother BEFORE getting a dog', 'Some pet parent MENTALITY be like', 'Average Indian parents and their furry child', 'Pet parents before leaving home'.
Educational 'mistakes' and 'Don't skip' hooks: 'Mistakes Indian cat parents always make', 'Biggest mistake', 'Don't skip'. Bold coloured text, one person talking to the camera.
Hinglish titles such as 'Mera wala bhi alag hai' (mine is different too): conversational, proud-owner tone.
List formats such as '50 shades of looking good' across several pets.
'POV: your favourite furry supervisor has a little announcement' followed by one plain offer ('Bookings are OPEN!') and city hashtags. 7 likes, so a small account.
observations.source: cuddlenpawsparadise post shared by the founder

observations.seen: Trade tag is dominated by shop owners talking to camera or walking through the shop, plus flyers with contact numbers.

hookTemplates: POV: you finally pick the collar for the wedding
Pet parents before leaving home: collar check
Mistakes pet parents make buying a collar
Don't skip this before you order a collar
Average pet parent at a Diwali shopping list
Pet parent mentality: matching kurta, matching collar
5 shades of gem collar, which one is yours?
Shop owners: the shelf corner that sells itself
topicAngles: Relatable pet-parent moments (Diwali guests, wedding outfits, evening walks) tied to a product
Mistake or checklist posts: measuring neck size, adjustable strap fit, what to pack for a walk (no safety or health claims)
Numbered 'shades' or 'styles' lists of hero products
Shop-owner posts: display ideas and why a gift range sells (bulk CTA, no prices)
captionRules: Hook line first, plain offer second, question or share prompt last
Mix English with a little Hinglish where it sounds natural
City hashtags plus 2 to 3 niche tags, never more than 11 in total
limits: Production can only render text hooks, product cards, stock-photo bursts and story grids. Anything needing a person on camera is a manual shoot, so the tool writes only the version it can render and lists any on-camera idea separately in notes.
